source.title: Urogenital Disease's Clinical Cases Records in Veterinary Patients I
source.author: Ariel Hernandez Camacho
source.publisherReportedSetting: Small animal clinical practice in the Caribbean
source.sourceLanguage: Primarily Spanish, preserved without machine translation
source.transformation: CSV to JSON; preserved every source field; added unique row IDs; normalized species spelling only; flagged NONE/blank diagnoses. No synthetic symptoms or disease labels added.
source.usage: Read-only published clinical reference examples. Not used to train the six-disease symptom classifier.
source.limitations: 17 rows; repeated patient IDs; one row without a reported diagnosis; urogenital scope differs from the existing model. Independent clinical validation and patient independence were not established.

records.clinicalHistory: REPORTA QUE TUVO UNA INFECCION EN UN OIDO HACE UN TIEMPO, Y MEJORO. PERO HOY NOTAN QUE LE MOLESTA UN OIDO Y QUE TOMA MUCHA AGUA SIN COMER MUCHO. NO VOMITOS NI DIARREA.
